description: This file defines a Java interface 'TransactionDao' for accessing transaction data related to payments within the sales manager application. It extends a generic DAO interface and includes a method to list transactions by order.

classes.name: TransactionDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for handling Transaction entities, providing methods to interact with transaction data associated with orders.

methods.name: listByOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions associated with a specific order.
